documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 financial performance with consolidated income of INR135.57 crores, marking a 79.91% year-on-year growth. Management highlighted robust order inflows, securing 11 orders worth INR209.24 crores, and noted an order book exceeding INR565.80 crores. Despite facing some input cost pressures from CRGO steel and transformer oil, the company expects full-year revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores and a PAT margin range of 9% to 12%. Operations at the new Kannur facility are scaling up, providing strong execution visibility for upcoming periods. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong financial performance in H1 FY27, with Total Income growing by 79.91% YoY to ₹135.57 Cr and Net Profit increasing by 45.09% YoY to ₹13.65 Cr, supported by healthy execution of its order book.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores for the full financial year FY27.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the order book to be maintained between INR600 crores and INR800 crores by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: The revenue potential of the Kannur facility at full capacity is estimated between ₹500 Cr and ₹550 Cr.
guidance.quote: Revenue Potential at Full Capacity: 500–550 Cr

guidance.claim: Management expects top line revenue for FY27 to be between INR250 crores and INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: So cautiously, we are telling between INR250 crores to INR300 crores we can make this year.

guidance.claim: PAT margin is expected to be maintained around 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are projected to be maintained between 18% to 20%.
guidance.quote: It will be maintained between 18% to 20%.

guidance.claim: Management projects a minimum 30% year-on-year increase in revenue.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment is very good, supported by interest from the Union Government and State Governments in expanding the transmission network.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, now the demand environment is very good and the sector is also very good. Since the Union Government and the State Governments showing much interest in expanding the transmission network, the demand is very high.

demand_outlook.claim: Market information indicates a good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for transformers is very high and expected to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain. And not only in India, but overall global -- across globe, the demand is good. Demand is very good.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflows remained strong during the quarter with 10 orders secured aggregating INR195.64 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Order inflows remained strong during the quarter. We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: Operationally, the ramp-up of our Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Total manufacturing capacity has expanded to approximately 9,000 MVA.
capex_expansion.quote: With an expanded manufacturing capacity of ~9,000 MVA and capabilities up to 200 MVA / 220 kV, the company is strategically positioned to address higher-value, large-scale projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Kannur manufacturing facility became operational during the previous quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: I would all like to brief touch upon our new Kannur manufacturing facility, which became operational during the previous quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to undertake a capex of around INR20 crores to INR22 crores for tank manufacturing capacities.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses to protect against raw material price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced pressure from higher prices of key inputs like CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses, offering protection against raw material price movements.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 17.42% and Net Profit margin was 10.07%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.42%, while Net Profit margin was 10.07% during the period.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price increases are absorbed and passed on due to price variation clauses present in almost 80% to 85% of orders.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause. So whatever the price rise will be passed on to the buyer.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefits increased due to the deployment of more than 250 people at the new plant compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: So now we have deployed more people for the new unit. So naturally, the employee benefits will high. The plant is almost 5x, 6x, 7x bigger than the existing one. So we need -- earlier here in the Unit 1, we have 60 to 80 people. Whereas in the new plant, we have deployed more than 250 people.

orders_capacity.claim: During H1 FY27, the company secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores with execution timelines between 7 and 17 months.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: The product mix of the INR565 crores order book includes distribution transformers at 16% to 17%, power transformers at 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers at 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: The peak revenue potential for both plants combined is up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores will be the peak revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr during the first half.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current consolidated order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr as on date.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book stood at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute the largest share of the order book at INR453.83 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%.

orders_capacity.claim: The expanded manufacturing capacity stands at approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.
orders_capacity.quote: The facility has strengthened our overall manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities extending up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approached banks for higher working capital limits.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes. Now we have approached the banks for higher limits.

capital_allocation.claim: There is no requirement for equity dilution for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Timing differences between input cost increases and corresponding adjustments under price variation clauses can impact margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted risks including customer concentration, working capital intensity, raw material price volatility, execution delays, and industry cyclicality.
risks_headwinds.quote:
Customer Concentration (EPC & Utilities) Diversifying into private sector & industrial clients 
 Working Capital Intensity Improving customer mix & tightening execution cycles 
 Raw Material Price Volatility (Copper, Steel, CRGO) Pass-through clauses & strategic sourcing 
 Execution Delays In-house manufacturing + support from Danya Electric 
 Industry Cyclicality (Power Capex) Exposure to renewables, industrial & infra segments 
 Scale-Up Risk (New Kannur Facility) Phased ramp-up & experienced execution team 
 Competitive Intensity Focus on high-MVA segment & strong EPC relationships

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical issues caused raw material price fluctuations which were managed via price variation clauses.
risks_headwinds.quote: And though there was a geopolitical issues were there due to that, the price rise of the raw materials are being absorbed because of this price variation clause, which we get from our buyers.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting 40% to 50% utilization of the new facility before March.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we are expecting 50% of -- 40% to 50% before this March.

management_commitments.claim: The company believes it should receive PGCIL approval within a year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year, within a year, we should -- we believe we should get the PGCIL approval.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix, and operating leverage.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to migrate to the main board stock exchange.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, yes. We have a plan to migrate to main board.

management_commitments.claim: The tank manufacturing facility construction is expected to be completed before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
